claim_text: After 12 cycles of selumetinib, 72% of children and 86% of parents with NF1 plexiform neurofibromas reported some improvement in tumor-related problems other than pain on the Global Impression of Change scale.
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). Outcome measures other than Pain Interference Index and visual acuity are not validated in NF1 (per authors); uncontrolled, unblinded patient-reported outcomes.
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
